inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped view uses GROUP_CONCAT to serialize multiple child values into one result column.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to an independently authored ordered label aggregation so the result type remains observable while unrelated joins, filtering, and duplicate data are removed.

fixture_notes: Two labels make the aggregate nonempty and the explicit order makes the result deterministic; the case isolates MariaDB's GROUP_CONCAT BLOB result metadata.
determinism_notes: The aggregate has an explicit rank order and uses no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE group_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, rank_value INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(label ORDER BY rank_value DESC SEPARATOR '|') AS labels FROM group_labels
